name: Roll Angle in Bounds
hint: Roll is supported from -90 to 90 degrees, making the robot’s side-to-side tilt available for dependable decisions.
instruction: Keep roll thresholds between -90 and 90 degrees and handle readings outside that interval separately.

examples.label: Example
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
if <(@codeyB roll angle° :: sensing) > (30)> then
say [Tilted sideways]
end
